title: The engine's database fails over, and the engine restarts
design_ref: The durable execution engine; Failure modes
purpose: Force the Multi-AZ database to fail over to its standby while three runs are in flight, then delete every engine server pod while a run is in flight. Nobody touches the runs; they must finish, once.

steps.display: aws rds reboot-db-instance --db-instance-identifier ds04-agentstate-db --force-failover   # the primary is taken away

checks.description: the standby in the other zone became the primary
checks.because: RDS Multi-AZ keeps a synchronous standby and moves the database's DNS name to it.

checks.description: all three runs reached the review step on their own
checks.because: The engine, the workers and the gateways retried their database connections until the new primary answered.

checks.description: each run finished, and each made exactly one branch and one pull request
checks.because: The ledger is in the same database: a step that was in flight when it failed over was retried and deduplicated.

checks.description: the model was called for every step of every run
checks.because: 11 decisions for each of 3 runs. Any step the failover interrupted mid-call was asked again, and shows above.

checks.description: the engine's servers were all replaced
checks.because: Kubernetes started new ones, which read everything from the database.

checks.description: the run in flight reached the review step without anyone's help
checks.because: The engine keeps no state of its own: a run is rows in PostgreSQL.
